description: Paste the LTE (and optionally 5G NR) bands of any cellular module or device and get a verdict on every network of one or more countries, with the bands it lacks, using the same rules as Band Atlas: bands cross-checked by two sources are scored, coverage bands under 1 GHz weigh double, good needs at least 60 percent and a coverage band.

countries.description: ISO codes or country names; at most 10

lte_bands.description: LTE bands, for example "B1 B3 B5 B7 B8 B20 B28" or "1,3,20"

nr_bands.description: Optional 5G NR bands, for example "n1 n28 n78"

name: check_bands
title: Check any band list
